headline: The PUBG Mobile World Cup Just Kicked Off Its Group Stage at the Esports World Cup
dek: 32 teams are battling it out for a share of a $3 million prize pool in Paris, as the mobile esports giant takes center stage.
body_markdown:
The Esports World Cup in Paris has opened its doors to a colossal mobile gaming showdown: the PUBG Mobile World Cup 2026. This tournament isn't just a side event; it's a major pillar of the ongoing global esports festival, bringing high-octane battle royale action to the forefront.

Players descended on Paris to kick off the Group Stage matches on August 6, marking the official start of what promises to be a thrilling competition. This initial phase of the tournament is set to run for four days, concluding on August 9, as teams fight to advance.

The scale of this year's event is truly impressive. A formidable 32 teams have entered the fray, each hungry for a piece of the substantial $3 million prize pool. These teams have been meticulously divided into two distinct groups, with 16 squads in each, ensuring every match is a crucible of strategy and skill. The competition is fierce, and the stakes are undeniably high as the world watches these mobile esports titans clash.
